asset.name: Hollow Delve sunken cavern
asset.visual_description:
A raised limestone shelf skirts a wide underground pool. Thin trickles darken
the cavern wall, and blunt stalactites hang over water almost black in the
recesses. Broken rock ledges overlap on the far bank. Sparse pale fungus clings
to damp shelves close to the waterline. A single hooded oil lamp rests in a
rock niche above the path, its small amber reflection caught in the still pool.
The walking shelf remains dry and level above the water.
